intra.subtitle: Choose below what you would like to learn about using the in-the-ear hearing aid.

como-desligar-ligar-aparelho.title: Turning the device on and off
como-desligar-ligar-aparelho.description: Learn how to properly turn the hearing aid on and off.
como-desligar-ligar-aparelho.paragraph1: To turn the device on, close the battery compartment.
como-desligar-ligar-aparelho.paragraph2: And to turn it off, open the battery compartment
como-desligar-ligar-aparelho.paragraph3: Always turn off the hearing aid when not in use to save the battery.

como-limpar-o-aparelho.title: How to clean the device
como-limpar-o-aparelho.description: How to properly clean the hearing aid.
como-limpar-o-aparelho.paragraph1: Clean your device at least once every 2 days. Wipe the device with a dry cloth. Use a brush/wax remover and/or a soft, dry cloth to remove any wax or dirt that has accumulated around the canal and battery compartment.
como-limpar-o-aparelho.paragraph2: Under no circumstances should you get the hearing aid wet.
como-limpar-o-aparelho.paragraph3: Ordinary alcohol, oils, and cleaning materials must not be used.

como-retirar-colocar-pilhas.title: Inserting and removing batteries
como-retirar-colocar-pilhas.description: When and how to change the hearing aid battery.
como-retirar-colocar-pilhas.paragraph1: Remove the seal from the battery and wait a minute, then open the battery compartment by placing your fingernail under the edge of the movable cover and gently pulling it out.
como-retirar-colocar-pilhas.paragraph2: Place the battery in the compartment, remember that the side with the + sign (flat side) of the battery must be facing upwards, or on the most open side of the battery compartment, then close the battery compartment.

onde-guardar-aparelho.title: Where to store the device
onde-guardar-aparelho.description: Tips for properly storing the device.
onde-guardar-aparelho.paragraph1: When not in use, it is important to store the device inside its case with the battery compartment open.
onde-guardar-aparelho.paragraph2: Always keep the room clean and free of moisture, you can also use a dehumidifier or silica.
onde-guardar-aparelho.paragraph3: It is important to always keep it out of the reach of small children and animals, and never get it wet or sleep with it.

tamanho-pilha-e-onde-comprar.title: Battery size and where to buy it
tamanho-pilha-e-onde-comprar.description: Where to buy the batteries and what the correct size is.
tamanho-pilha-e-onde-comprar.paragraph1: The battery size of your hearing aid is (battery number for each type of hearing aid).
tamanho-pilha-e-onde-comprar.paragraph2: The batteries are sold in hearing aid stores, your hearing care professional can give you the address of one. You can also buy batteries online.
tamanho-pilha-e-onde-comprar.paragraph3: If possible, pick them up at the health center, because in some cities they are provided free of charge, check if this service is available in your city.

como-trocar-filtro-cera.title: How to change the wax filter
como-trocar-filtro-cera.description: Learn when and how to replace the wax filter.
como-trocar-filtro-cera.paragraph1: With the appropriate tool, remove the used wax protector.
como-trocar-filtro-cera.paragraph2: On the other side of the stem is the clean filter.
como-trocar-filtro-cera.paragraph3: Insert the clean filter into the outlet.

como-colocar-retirar-aparelho.title: How to insert and remove the device
como-colocar-retirar-aparelho.description: How to properly insert and remove the hearing aid from the ear.
como-colocar-retirar-aparelho.paragraph1: How to insert: before inserting the device into your ear, make sure that the battery is inserted correctly and the cover is closed properly. To insert your hearing aid, hold the rod used for insertion and removal with your thumb and index finger. Insert the device into your canal as far as you feel resistance.
como-colocar-retirar-aparelho.paragraph2: Let go of the rod used for insertion and removal and gently push the device in until it is comfortably inside your ear. To make insertion easier, you can use your other hand to pull the pinna (opening the ear) away from the ear as you push the device in.
como-colocar-retirar-aparelho.paragraph3: How to remove: to remove the device, pull the stem gently and carefully.

como-identificar-cada-orelha.title: Identifying which device belongs to each ear
como-identificar-cada-orelha.description: How to identify the correct hearing aid for each ear.
como-identificar-cada-orelha.paragraph1: The device in the right ear has a red mark. The device in the left ear has a blue mark.
como-identificar-cada-orelha.paragraph2: If observation is difficult, ask the hearing care professional to make a larger mark.

como-saber-pilhas-acabando.title: How to tell when the battery is running out?
como-saber-pilhas-acabando.description: How to identify when the hearing aid battery is low.
como-saber-pilhas-acabando.paragraph1: When the battery is running low, you will hear a signal (beep or whistle). When the battery is completely drained, you will notice that the hearing aid stops working.
como-saber-pilhas-acabando.paragraph2: Batteries are toxic and must be disposed of in special waste.

limpeza-oliva.description: How to properly clean the hearing aid dome.
limpeza-oliva.paragraph1: Use a damp cloth to carefully clean the dome. Check that there is no wax or any other type of obstruction in the dome.

limpeza-tubo-fino.title: How to clean the thin tube
limpeza-tubo-fino.description: How to properly clean the thin tube of the hearing aid.
limpeza-tubo-fino.paragraph1: The tube should be cleaned with a cleaning thread. First, remove the thin tube from the hearing aid.
limpeza-tubo-fino.paragraph2: Then push the cleaning wire through the entire thin tube. After checking that there is no obstruction in the thin tube, fit the thin tube back into the hearing aid.

retirar-pilhas.paragraph2: Place the battery in the compartment, remember that the side with the + sign (flat side) of the battery must be facing upwards, or on the most open side of the battery compartment, then close the battery compartment.

tamanho-pilha.description: Where to buy batteries and what the correct size is.
tamanho-pilha.paragraph1: The battery size of your hearing aid is (battery number for each type of hearing aid).
tamanho-pilha.paragraph2: The batteries are sold in hearing aid stores, your hearing care professional can give you the address of one. You can also buy batteries online.
tamanho-pilha.paragraph3: If possible, pick them up at the health center, because in some cities they are provided free of charge, check if this service is available in your city.

colocar-retirar.title: How to insert and remove the device
colocar-retirar.description: How to properly insert and remove the hearing aid from the ear.
colocar-retirar.paragraph1: How to insert: before inserting the device into your ear, make sure the battery is inserted correctly and the cap is closed properly. To insert, hold the thin tube and dome with your thumb and index finger. Carefully insert it into the ear canal. Then gently squeeze with the tip of your finger. Carefully place the device behind your ear. To make insertion easier, you can use your other hand to pull the pinna (opening the ear) away from the ear while you push the thin tube in slightly.
colocar-retirar.paragraph2: How to remove: to remove, take the device out from behind your ear and gently pull on the thin tube, holding it as close to the rigid part as possible.
colocar-retirar.paragraph3: Pull up the ear pinna to open the canal, helping to release the thin tube when removed.

limpeza.title: How to change the mold tube
limpeza.paragraph1: Use tweezers or pliers to remove the silicone tube from the mold. Then make a diagonal cut at one end of the tube. Then fit the smaller end of the tube into the mold. .
limpeza.paragraph2: Use the tweezers or pliers to help pull the tube out. Pull until it fits the angle of the tube. Cut off the excess tube with the scissors.
limpeza.paragraph3: Use the previous tube to level the height of the new tube. Fit the tube onto the hook of the device.

guardar.description: Tips for properly storing the device.
guardar.paragraph1: When not in use, it is important to store the device inside its case with the battery compartment open.

guardar.paragraph3: It is important to always keep it out of the reach of small children and animals, and never get it wet or sleep with it.

colocar-retirar.title: How to insert and remove the device
colocar-retirar.description: How to properly insert and remove the hearing aid from the ear.
colocar-retirar.paragraph1: How to insert: first make sure that the mold and the device match the ears (right and left), then hold the device without turning it in your hand, positioning the device and the mold in the same direction, place the mold on the ear and fit it, then place the device behind the ear, if the mold doesn't fit it may have been swapped with the one on the other ear.
colocar-retirar.paragraph2: How to remove: remove the device from the back of the ear, detach the earmold from the ear by removing the upper part first and rotating forward until the earmold is completely removed from the ear. Avoid pulling on the plastic tube to remove the earmold, otherwise it may come off.

trocar-tubo.title: Replace the earmold tube
trocar-tubo.description: How to properly replace the earmold tube.
trocar-tubo.paragraph1: Using tweezers or pliers, remove the silicone tube from the earmold. Then cut one end of the tube diagonally. After that, insert the smaller end of the tube into the earmold.
trocar-tubo.paragraph2: Use tweezers or pliers to help pull the tube. Pull until it aligns with the angle of the tube.
trocar-tubo.paragraph3: Cut the excess tube with scissors. Use the previous tube to level the height of the new tube. Attach the tube to the hearing aid hook.
